name: Lumi’s potion
synopsis: At night, in her cottage workshop, the witch Lumi brews a glowing violet potion and turns it to gold. Each shot shows one thing the plugin does: a shot made from its text, a shot that starts from the last image of the one before, a shot that casts Lumi’s card with her picture, and a shot between a first and a last image.
direction.univers: A witch's cottage workshop at night, where a glowing violet potion is brewed. A quiet tale without dialogue.
direction.personnages: Lumi, a witch in her thirties, is the only person in the film; the shots that do not name her show no one.
direction.photographie: Realistic cinematic shots, each one continuous take with smooth slow camera motion, shallow depth of field, light motivated by the hearth and the candles.
direction.palette: Midnight blue, copper and cream, warm firelight and candlelight, the violet of the potion as the constant colour, gold for the magic.
direction.rythme: Calm and slow: four shots of five seconds, no abrupt movement.
card.lumi.label: Lumi
card.lumi.text: a woman in her thirties, with fair skin and light freckles, amber eyes and long wavy lilac-grey hair, wearing a worn midnight-blue pointed witch's hat of felt with a golden star pin, a midnight-blue velvet dress with an embroidered cream collar, and silver rings
card.lumi.props: a straight glass potion bottle with a cork stopper, a blank cream paper label and a glowing violet liquid
card.workshop.label: Workshop
card.workshop.text: an old witch's cottage workshop with rough timber beams, a stone hearth with a crackling fire, a dented copper cauldron, dusty glass jars, bundles of dried herbs and melted candles
shot.1.label: The workshop
shot.1.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the empty workshop at night, a straight glass potion bottle with a cork stopper, a blank cream paper label and a glowing violet liquid on the oak workbench in the middle, the camera slowly pushing in towards the bench.
shot.2.label: The potion
shot.2.prompt: Close-up of the potion bottle on the oak workbench, a straight glass bottle sealed with a cork stopper, with a blank cream paper label, the violet liquid swirling with glowing golden particles, a thin mist rising from the neck, the camera still slowly pushing in.
shot.3.label: Lumi
shot.3.prompt: Lumi stands at the oak workbench of the workshop at night, lifts the potion bottle, looks at it and smiles without a word, medium close-up, the camera slowly pushing in.
shot.4.label: From violet to gold
shot.4.prompt: Close-up of the potion bottle on the oak workbench: the glowing violet liquid slowly turns to molten gold, golden sparks swirl around the neck, the camera holding still.
